amendment_reason: V4 reserves disjoint 64-pair and 128-pair GUE candidate pools because local BPE qualification can attrit pairs before selecting the frozen 16-pair calibration and 32-pair preflight sets. Native edits, target cohort, measurements, and scientific gates are unchanged.

scope.behavior: target-specific supervised promoter-margin loss caused by native nucleotide edits in the D8-nominated +11:+21 interval
scope.qualification_gate: replicated native-sequence necessity before any residual-source or mediator outcome is opened
scope.licensed_if_native_gate_passes: the nucleotide sequence or GC content of the geometry-qualified +11:+21 interval contributes to the classifier's promoter margin on the declared cohort
explicitly_excluded: DCE-II, MTE, DPE, or DPR identity without an independently qualified feature test
mediation by L11H2/L11H5 unless clean-state rescue beats the matched layer-11 pair family

native_interventions.dinucleotide_reorder: length-preserving nonidentity reorder of +11:+21 with exact mononucleotide and linear-dinucleotide counts
native_interventions.gc_depletion: three G/C bases changed by G-to-A or C-to-T transitions, preserving purine/pyrimidine class
native_interventions.retokenization_policy: strictly local and target-control geometry matched

measurement.target_loss: clean target margin minus native-edited target margin
measurement.control_loss: clean pseudo-TSS margin minus native-edited pseudo-TSS margin

native_primary_gates.tracing_opens_if: at least one native operation passes in development and unchanged confirmation

source_tracing.candidate_generation: patch clean post-layer residual states into native-edited runs across layer by TSS-relative position
source_tracing.layer_family: embedding output and all 12 post-layer residual states
source_tracing.matched_nulls: same-layer equal-token-dose patches at the other 29 tiles
source_tracing.multiplicity: maximum sign-flip correction across the complete layer-by-tile family

mediation.direct_rescue: restore clean L11H2/L11H5 CLS head contexts into native-edited runs
mediation.path_block: after clean source-residual rescue, clamp the tested layer-11 CLS head pair back to its native-edited context
mediation.candidate_pair_nulls: all 45 candidate-excluding two-head pairs in layer 11
mediation.MLP_alternative: if the late-pair path is null, test separately frozen equal-node CLS MLP-write rescue rather than relabeling the null
